coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: 1670 Owens Garage
record.summary: A parking garage at 1670 Owens Street in Mission Bay (Assessor class 'Garages (Commercial)', 7 stories on the roll; DBI permit 200801243180 describes a 6-story, 823-space garage), completed 2010 per the DBI permit (completed 2010-01-29) and the Assessor's year built. No UCSF announcement was found; UCSF operation, the location opposite Kaiser Permanente Mission Bay and a C Street entrance are not confirmed by any source read.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. The footprint lies in active Assessor parcel 8709022 (1670 Owens St; in the secured roll, class 'Garages (Commercial)', year built 2010, 7 stories, College/University exemption in the 2025 roll), so a blklot exists that could be joined through status.csv; the real OSM building footprint is kept as the geometry. Neither cited source (OSM, the Mission Bay TMA rates page) says the garage is UCSF-owned.

changes.text: The record said UCSF land is not on the Assessor's secured roll and that the year built came only from PropertyShark. DataSF's Assessor roll carries 1670 Owens St as parcel 8709022 (garage, built 2010, 7 stories, College/University exemption), and DBI permit 200801243180 is complete as of 2010-01-29 and describes an 823-space, 6-story garage. The completion date, summary, open questions and map caveat now cite these instead of PropertyShark (which blocks automated fetches), the notes now say 823 spaces rather than an unconfirmed ~820, and an 823-space capacity fact was added. 'UCSF's garage opposite Kaiser with a C Street entrance' is noted as not confirmed by cited sources. The $52.8M cost entry now cites the DataSF permit records, the NAIP aerial credit names the USDA Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, and the Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural.

open_questions: Correction (2026-09-29): 1670 Owens is on the Assessor secured roll as parcel 8709022 (Garages (Commercial), year built 2010, 7 stories, with a College/University exemption in the 2025 roll), so a blklot exists; the DBI permit for the garage (200801243180) was filed on block 8709 lot 009 and is complete (2010-01-29). No UCSF announcement or Regents document dating this specific garage was found; the earlier note that the year built comes only from PropertyShark and that UCSF land is not on the secured roll no longer holds for this parcel.

Searched UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings agenda items for a 'Mission Bay' parking structure at Owens Street or matching this garage's ~820-874 space, ~250,000 gsf, nine-level profile (the November 2003 item for the separate Building 23B/Third Street Garage has very similar statistics, so a same-era Owens Street garage item likely exists but was not located in this pass); WRNS Studio's own award-winning 'Mission Bay Parking Structure'/'UCSF Parking Structure' project (2010 AIA SF Citation Award, cited elsewhere as 'Mission Bay Block 27 Parking Structure', 1,420 spaces on seven floors) was considered but not used here, since its capacity and floor count don't match this record's OSM tagging (5 levels) and its address was never confirmed to be 1670 Owens -- left unlinked rather than guessed.
Capacity: DBI's permit description says 823 spaces (now recorded as a fact); parking aggregators' ~820 figure agrees.
No architect or design-build team was identified for this specific address.

2026-09-22 pass: another candidate was checked and ruled out. UCSF's William J. Rutter Community Center (Block 21B, architect Ricardo Legorreta with MBT/Perkins+Will, per a May 2000 Regents design-approval item and Forell/Elsesser's own project page) has its own, separately-addressed parking garage -- confirmed via UCSF-affiliated contact pages and parking directories to be at 1625 Owens St, not this record's 1670 Owens St. These are two distinct structures a few hundred feet apart; the Rutter Center's own garage material does not apply to this record.
